deck_description:
1. Your core engine: the cards that start your plays

These are the cards you want to see early because they help you get monsters onto the field, access Tribute Summons, or find the cards you need.

Edea the Heavenly Squire

Eidos the Underworld Squire

Tessera the Primal Squire

The Monarchs Revolt

2. Your boss monsters: how you disrupt the opponent

Erebus the Underworld Monarch

Caius the Shadow Monarch

Caius the Mega Monarch

Delg the Dark Monarch

3. Your Spell engine: draw, search, and fuel

Pantheism of the Monarchs

Triple Tactics Thrust

Triple Tactics Talent

Reinforcement of the Army

Foolish Burial

Role: Monster setup.

Sends a monster from your Deck to your GY.

Best synergy: Put Eidos the Underworld Squire in the GY so you can use its banish effect to revive another Squire, or set up a monster that can be recovered by one of your Monarch effects.

 

Foolish Burial Goods

Role: Spell/Trap setup.

Sends a Spell/Trap from your Deck to your GY.

Best synergy: Put Pantheism in the GY to use its search effect, or send a Monarch Trap such as Prime Monarch or Monarchic Perfection to prepare its graveyard-related plays.

 

Time-Tearing Morganite

For when you have no options left and need an additional tribute summon or normal summon.

Succumbing-Song Morganite

Searches Time-Tearing Morganite also helps during Battle Phase.

 
 

Spell Card "Soul Exchange"

For when you run out of normal summons or simply need to bait their negate. Can be searched with Triple Tactics Thrust.

4. Your Tribute tools and lockdown cards

 

The Monarchs Stormforth

Domain of the True Monarchs

Escalation of the Monarchs

The Prime Monarch

Monarchic Perfection

The Monarchs Erupt

The Monarchs Awaken

Forbidden Crown

 

Spell Card "Soul Exchange"

 

5. Your hand traps: stopping the opponent before your turn

Maxx "C"

Droll & Lock Bird
